android.desc: Make Android Quick Settings more useful with Shortcutter 2. Add custom Quick Settings tiles, open apps and Android settings, and put your favourite tools in the pull-down panel you already use. Shortcutter is more than a tile manager. Create shortcuts, build home screen widgets and keep your favourite apps and actions within reach through a customisable Sidebar or Floating Toolbox. QUICK SETTINGS, YOUR WAY Make your Android Quick Settings panel work harder: • Add custom tiles for apps, activities and shortcuts • Open websites, contacts and supported Android settings • Access built-in tools, system actions and useful information • Arrange Shortcutter tiles alongside your existing system tiles • Find the tiles you want with shortcut search Choose your tiles in Shortcutter, then add them through Android's Quick Settings editor. No replacement notification panel needed. CREATE SHORTCUTS FOR ALMOST ANYTHING Use Shortcutter as an Android shortcut maker for: • Installed apps and supported app activities • Websites, links, contacts, calls and messages • Display, sound, accessibility and system settings • Home screen shortcuts and launcher actions • Built-in utilities and custom Quick Settings tiles Reach those shortcuts from your home screen, widgets, Quick Settings, Sidebar or Floating Toolbox. Shortcutter also works with compatible automation apps such as Tasker. SIDEBAR & FLOATING TOOLBOX Keep your tools accessible while using other apps. Open a swipe-out Sidebar from the left, right or bottom of your screen, or use a floating toolbox for quick access. Customise the shortcuts, position, icon styles, layout and appearance. Theme Studio includes live previews, colours, gradients, borders, backgrounds and more. HOME SCREEN WIDGETS & LAUNCHER SHORTCUTS Pin individual shortcuts to your home screen, create grouped shortcut widgets or use weather and location widgets. Launch supported tools directly from your app drawer or launcher. BUILT-IN TOOLS & ANDROID CONTROLS • QR and barcode reader, including camera and gallery scanning • QR code generator for contacts, links and other information • Floating calculator, stopwatch, timer, counter and dice • Weather forecasts, next alarm, battery and device information • Flashlight, brightness, display and screen orientation tools • Screen capture, screen recording and media controls • Clipboard tools, reminders and file shortcuts • Android Zoom

In anyone was wondering how to quick toggle grayscale on android. I came across a couple of articles on breaking phone addiction by using a grayscale filter awhile back, but couldn't figure out how to toggle it quickly in Android. This app (not affiliated) is able to after granting secure settings permission via ADB. Pretty happy so far.
